description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity for an Android task management app. It manages UI components such as the task list RecyclerView, toolbar, floating action button, and integrates with a ViewModel to handle task data, including add/edit/delete interactions and swipe-to-delete features with undo.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity displaying a list of tasks with options to add, edit, delete, and clear completed tasks. Implements task item listener interface.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up ViewModel, adapter, swipe behavior, and observers for task list.

methods.name: showAboutDialog
methods.description: Displays an about dialog with app version information.

methods.name: onToggleCompleted
methods.description: Handles toggling completion status of a task and updates the ViewModel.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Initiates editing a specified task by opening the dialog fragment.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a task and offers undo via snackbar.
